aloud.meaning: so others can hear your voice

explanation.meaning: a description of what something means

amount.meaning: how much there is of something

behave.meaning: do or say things in a particular way

emphasise.meaning: give something more attention and importance

pause.meaning: when you stop reading or speaking for a short time

humid.meaning: warm and damp in the air
humid.example: The air felt ___ before the storm.

athletic.meaning: strong, healthy and often good at sports

generous.meaning: happy to give more money or help than is usual

honest.meaning: an honest person tells the truth

intelligent.meaning: able to learn and understand things quickly

depressed.meaning: unhappy, often for a long time, and without hope for the future

mood.meaning: the way we feel at a particular time

birth.meaning: the moment a baby is born

middle-aged.meaning: in the middle of their lives

medicine.meaning: something you take to treat an illness

casual.meaning: comfortable and suitable for informal situations

stylish.meaning: wearing nice clothes and looking attractive

ingredients.meaning: the different food you need to make a particular meal

fluent.meaning: able to speak naturally without stopping

experience.meaning: knowledge you get from doing something such as a job

entertainment.meaning: things you see or do to enjoy yourself

orchestra.meaning: a large group of musicians who play different instruments

explore.meaning: go round a new place to see what is there

coast.meaning: the land close to the sea

shore.meaning: the place where the sea meets the land

series.meaning: a number of programmes that have the same characters or deal with the same subject

texting.meaning: sending short written messages from one phone to another

create.example: The students will ___ a short video.
create.tip: A creation is something you create.

burglary.meaning: getting into a building, usually someone’s home, and stealing something

calculator.meaning: a small electronic machine for working out numbers

antique.meaning: an object that is old and often rare or beautiful

develop.meaning: grow or change and become more advanced

govern.meaning: control the affairs of a city or country

improve.tip: An improvement is a change for the better.

invent.meaning: produce or design something completely new

relax.meaning: rest, and feel calm and comfortable

afterwards.meaning: at a later time but usually the same day

eventually.meaning: finally, after a long time or a lot of problems

relevant.meaning: connected to and useful for the particular job

signature.meaning: the special way you have of writing your own name

argument.example: The small mistake led to an ___.

generalisation.meaning: saying that something is true most of the time or in most situations

delay.meaning: when something arrives later than expected

agree.example: I ___ with your idea about the trip.
agree.tip: Agree and agreement both start with agree.

achieve.meaning: to succeed in reaching a goal
achieve.example: The team hopes to ___ its target this year.
achieve.tip: An achievement is something you achieve.

avoid.tip: Avoidance is the act of avoiding something.

consider.tip: Give an idea consideration when you consider it.

encourage.meaning: to give someone confidence or support
encourage.example: Good teachers ___ students to ask questions.
encourage.tip: Encouragement helps someone feel able to try.

expand.meaning: to become larger or more detailed
expand.example: The company plans to ___ its services.

reduce.meaning: to make something smaller or less
reduce.example: We should ___ the amount of waste we produce.
reduce.tip: A reduction is the result of reducing something.

dead.example: The plant was ___ after the frost.

dirty.example: His shoes were ___ after the walk.

kind.example: It was ___ of her to help.

argue.meaning: to disagree in an angry discussion

accept.meaning: to say yes to an offer or idea

active.meaning: doing many things; full of energy
active.example: He stays ___ by walking every day.

advice.meaning: an opinion about what someone should do

at least.meaning: not less than a stated amount

choice.example: You have a ___ between tea and coffee.

entrance.meaning: a place where you go in

filthy.example: The floor was ___ after the storm.

highlighter pen.meaning: a pen used to mark important text
highlighter pen.example: Use a ___ on the key words.

opposite.meaning: a word or idea with a contrary meaning

routine.meaning: a regular way of doing things
routine.example: Reading is part of my evening ___.

rub sth out.meaning: to remove writing with an eraser

rubber.meaning: a small object used to erase pencil marks
rubber.example: Use a ___ to correct the answer.

synonym.meaning: a word with a similar meaning

blow (ing).meaning: to move air, as the wind does
blow (ing).example: The wind is ___ across the field.

chilly.example: Take a coat; it is ___ outside.

cloud.meaning: a mass of tiny water drops in the sky
cloud.example: A white ___ moved across the sky.

cloudy.example: It was too ___ to see the stars.

come out.example: The sun will ___ after the rain.

heavy (rain).meaning: rain that falls in large amounts

light (rain/shower).meaning: rain that falls in a small amount

lightning.meaning: a bright flash in a storm

snow.meaning: frozen white flakes falling from clouds

storm.meaning: very bad weather with wind or rain

strong (wind).example: There was a ___ by the sea.

sun.meaning: the star that gives Earth light and heat

thick fog.meaning: dense fog that makes it hard to see

thunder.meaning: a loud sound during a storm

thunderstorm.meaning: a storm with thunder and lightning

wet.example: The grass was ___ after the rain.

windy.example: It is too ___ for a picnic.
